class.name: GameplayReplicationFragmenter
class.brief_description: Bounded fragmentation and deterministic reassembly for large replicated state.
class.description: Splits an encoded state transfer into explicitly numbered chunks below the adapter's safe packet budget. Reassembly accepts out-of-order chunks and identical duplicates, rejects conflicting duplicates and stale sequences, bounds memory and chunk counts, and expires incomplete transfers.

method.name: accept_fragment
method.description: Returns a dictionary whose status is [code]pending[/code], [code]duplicate[/code], [code]complete[/code], or [code]rejected[/code]. A complete result contains the reassembled byte payload.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears pending assemblies, completed sequence history, and the last error.

method.name: expire_assemblies
method.description: Drops incomplete assemblies past the timeout and returns the number dropped.

method.name: fragment
method.description: Returns ordered chunk dictionaries, or an empty array and [member last_error] when limits reject the transfer.

method.name: get_pending_assembly_count
method.description: Returns the number of incomplete transfers currently consuming bounded reassembly state.

members.member: Maximum lifetime of an incomplete transfer.
Raw bytes in each chunk. The allowed range keeps the encoded envelope below the packet budget.
Machine-readable reason for the last fragmentation or reassembly failure.

signal.name: assembly_failed
signal.description: Emitted for rejected or expired assembly state.
